Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class IdentityController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.IdentityController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IdentitiesApi
@RestController public class IdentityController extends Object implements IdentitiesApi
Manages the identities of external providers linked to the authenticated account (the operations of the contract). Linking one is not here: it happens when the user signs in with the provider (the verified e-mail address, or the provisioning of a new account), so the API lists and unlinks.

    • unlinkIdentity

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> unlinkIdentity(UUID id)
      Unlinks an identity of the authenticated account.
      Specified by:
      unlinkIdentity in interface IdentitiesApi
      Parameters:
      id - identifier of the link.
      Returns:
      204 No Content.
      Throws:
      FederatedIdentityNotFoundException - if the account has no such identity.
      LastSignInMethodException - if the identity is the last way the account can sign in.
      InsufficientUserAuthenticationException - if the account has a confirmed second factor and the token does not show a recent multi-factor sign-in.
